strapiBlog.title: DAMAC Partners with Chelsea FC to Launch First-Ever Football-Themed Real Estate Project in Dubai
strapiBlog.short_description: Football enthusiasts and luxury property investors have exciting news to celebrate. Chelsea Football Club and DAMAC Properties just introduced Chelsea Residences by DAMAC, the world’s first football-themed residential development.

data.text:
Football enthusiasts and luxury property investors have exciting news to celebrate. Chelsea Football Club and DAMAC Properties just introduced Chelsea Residences by DAMAC, the world’s first football-themed residential development. This one-of-a-kind project is already making waves and we're here to tell you all about it.

About DAMAC-Chelsea Partnership

The DAMAC Chelsea partnership symbolizes a groundbreaking fusion of football passion and premier real estate innovation. Announced as a long-term global collaboration, txhis partnership highlights DAMAC Properties' commitment to luxury and excellence, mirroring Chelsea FC's values of high-end style and future-forward vision.

To celebrate this monumental venture, DAMAC Properties branding will appear prominently on Chelsea FC men's and women's team shirts, marking their debut during the men’s UEFA Conference League semi-final against Djurgården.

What to Expect from Chelsea Residences by DAMAC

Chelsea Residences by DAMAC is set to redefine luxury living with its exclusive football-inspired amenities and sophisticated design. The project, comprising over 1,400 luxurious apartments in 1 to 3-bedroom layouts. 

Each unit will offer unmatched waterfront views and high-performance spaces designed to reflect Chelsea FC’s spirit of excellence. Let’s take a look at the exclusive features and amenities this branded project will offer:

  • Rooftop football pitch
  • Architecture by globally acclaimed Gensler
  • Infinity sand pool
  • Aqua gym
  • Starlit spa

As the premier Chelsea football club Dubai project, these residences are envisioned not only to cater to passionate fans but also to discerning investors seeking unique properties with exceptional branding. The development promises to blend luxury, comfort, and the unparalleled spirit of football, setting new standards in football-themed real estate Dubai.

faqs.question: What is Chelsea Residences by DAMAC?

data.answer: Chelsea Residences by DAMAC is an innovative, football-themed residential project resulting from a partnership between Chelsea FC and DAMAC Properties.

faqs.question: Where will Chelsea Residences by DAMAC be located?

data.answer: The residences will be located in Maritime City, Dubai’s newest beachfront area.

faqs.question: Is Chelsea Residences by DAMAC a good investment opportunity?

data.answer: Yes, being a first-of-its-kind branded development with global appeal, it is expected to offer high ROI and strong rental demand.

faqs.question: When will Chelsea Residences by DAMAC be completed?

data.answer: Prices for Chelsea Residences start from AED 2.1M for 1BHK and it can go up to AED 4.77M for a three-bedroom apartment.
